locate_object_by_qualified_name: locate a Python class or function by its fully qualified module path string
convert_target_to_string: convert a Python object to its compressed fully qualified module path string
use_registry_for_backward_compat: use the fvcore Registry class for backward compatible object registration and lookup
locate_with_hydra_fallback: locate an object using pydoc with a hydra fallback for tricky import paths
compress_module_path: compress a module path by finding the shortest prefix that still resolves to the same object
